An axis is aligned left, right, centre or fill (declared, else a centred block when the content sits off the margin on both sides, else fill): fill wants both sides at the margin, left or right the leading side at the margin and the trailing side at least the margin, centre both sides at least the margin (equal sides are L7b's); owner, 2026-10-26
